notes.title: Seeds Beta is Out, Join Now!
notes.content:
Grow, collect, and trade rare plants in this relaxing inventory game. Cultivate a thriving virtual garden and build your collection of plants.

[b]Here's what awaits you in the Seeds Beta:[/b]
[list]
[*] Cultivate a vibrant garden: Plant seeds, watch them grow, and harvest unique plants.
[*] Discover a wealth of rare plants: From common to epic, with an exclusive epic plant only available for those who join the beta.
[*] Trade on the Steam Marketplace: Sell and buy plants and seeds from other players to expand your collection.
[/list]

Your feedback is essential!

We're excited to share Seeds with you and eager to hear your thoughts. Your feedback will help us refine the game and make it even better.

To join the Seeds Beta, access: https://beta.seeds-game.com/ Limited spots available!
